title: [DOCS] Undocumented "Classify session states" and its impact on privacy and costs
body: ### Documentation Type Missing documentation (feature not documented) ### Documentation Location _No response_ ### Section/Topic Session States ### Current Documentation As of today the https://claude.ai/new#settings/claude-code pages opens in a popup a has the "Classify session states" toggle turned on. The description says > Allow Claude to automatically classify sessions as blocked, ready for review, or done. Classifying sessions counts towards your plan usage. Applies to new sessions. ### What's Wrong or Missing? There seem to be no explanation on https://code.claude.com/docs of what "Classify session states" does, and its impact on privacy and costs. ### Suggested Improvement Explain on https://code.claude.com/docs what "Classify session states" does, and its impact on privacy and costs. ### Impact Medium - Makes feature difficult to understand ### Additional Context _No response_
author: marcindulak

top_comments.author: arandomhooman
top_comments.body: +1, feels very confusing. Please document it's impact.
